crm_notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company building a conversational assistant + semantic search across product docs. Started on hosted API; tests look good for correctness but P95 latency spikes on long context windows. Wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. Key ask: POC that proves canary rollout and automated fallback to smaller model/other region when capacity or latency SLOs breach.

POC scope (customer):
- 3-week Dedicated POC (staged): baseline perf, canary routing, resilience tests.
- Workloads: chat (conversational stateful sessions), document embeddings for search, re-ranking pipeline for top-k candidates.
- Targets: chat P95 < 120ms (token gen), embedding throughput 50 qps sustained, rerank 350ms median.
- Cost sensitivity: want clear estimate for steady state + burst; open to 1-year reserved commit for 15% discount.

Canary + Fallback plan proposed with SE:
- Canary group: 5% of traffic routed to Dedicated cluster variant A (fp16 quantized), rest to Hosted for comparison.
- Monitoring: per-route P95, token cost, error rate, KV cache hit ratio. Automated alert if P95 > 150ms or error rate > 1%.
- Fallback actions: 1) automatic traffic shift to model-variant-B (smaller quantized variant) in same region; 2) if capacity/congestion persists, failover to Hosted region-us-east (verified compatibility) with metadata tag to preserve routing intent; 3) if quality regression detected vs canary prompt set, rollback to previous model version and open SE incident.
- Rollback runbook: snapshot canary model config, escalate to on-call SE (Marcus), revert routing policy, run smoke prompts from saved eval set, update ticket in JIRA.

Security / compliance notes:
- Infosec requires SSO + audit logs and optional customer-managed KMS for key material. Data residency: US-only by default, potential EU region later.

Customer quotes/snippets: "Need predictable latency during peak demo days — can’t have unpredictable tail latency." — Head of Product.
